requires.description: Profiles this one builds on, by name: each a layer before it.

features.description: What a target or a requirer may turn on.

vars.description: Variables templates and paths use; the target answers them.

scaffolds.description: Groups of starter files, each written once, when none of its sentinels is there.

files.description: Managed files, by path in the target, as found under `files/`; a path may use variables.

name.description: Names the profile: in its source, among the layers, in output, and in `from`.

version.description: For humans; a git source is pinned by commit.

devset.description: The devset versions the profile works with.

items.description: A feature of a profile; never `default`, which names the list of features on by default.

default-features.description: Whether its default features are on; `true` unless set.

optional.description: Whether it applies only when a feature activates it.

path.description: The directory in the repository its profiles are in; only with `git`.

Features.description: The `[features]` table: `default`, and every feature with what it turns on.

prompt.description: What to ask; the name if unset.

MergeSpec.description: A `[merge]` table: defaults in `profile.toml`, decisions in `.devset/config.toml`.

on-conflict.description: What an update does when a file conflicts.

driver.description:
A merge program, with `%O %A %B %P` substituted.

From a profile it is only a suggestion: devset never runs a program a profile names.

OnConflict.description: What an update does when a file conflicts.

oneOf.description: Write every other file and advance the lock; conflicts wait in `.devset/conflicts/`.
Write nothing but the conflicts until every one is resolved.

ScaffoldSpec.description: A `[scaffolds.name]` entry: a group of starter files, written together once.

unless.description:
Paths or globs of which any, there before the run, means the target has its own: the group
is not written. A string or a list; none writes the group when the profile is first
applied.

Patterns.description: Paths or globs in the target: a string, or a list of them.

policy.description: How devset manages the file; `owned` unless set, and `once` in a scaffold.

validate.description: How a merged result is checked; inferred from the extension unless set.

template.description: Whether the file is a template, rendered with the answers and the `devset` object.

scope.description: How much of the file devset owns: all of it, the keys the payload defines, or a block.

comment.description: The comment syntax of a block's markers, where devset does not know the file type's.

executable.description: Whether devset writes the file executable, mode 755, as a script it ships must be.

scaffold.description: The scaffold group the file belongs to, written with it.

starter.description: For a part, a file under `files/` the target's file starts from when it is absent.

when.description: When the entry applies; always, unless set.

oneOf.description: The profile is authoritative; local edits are drift.
Local edits are kept, and merged with the profile's.
Written once if absent; the target's from then on.

Format.description: How a file is checked after a merge: it must parse, with no duplicate keys.

oneOf.description: JSON with comments and trailing commas (JSONC), a superset of JSON.

Scope.description: How much of a file a profile owns.

oneOf.description: Every leaf the payload, a partial document, defines; the file's other keys are the target's.
One comment-marked block, named after the profile; the file's other lines are the target's.

Comment.description: A line comment syntax, which a block's markers are written in.

When.description: When an entry applies: every condition holds.

features.description: Features of this profile that are on.

items.description: A feature of a profile; never `default`, which names the list of features on by default.
A profile's name, unique in its source and among a target's layers.

vars.description: Variables of this profile, each answered with one of its values.

exists.description:
Paths or globs that will exist when the run finishes, whole files or parts; may use
variables.
